title: the graveyard shift
body:
fingers sliding across the wooden countertop,
i feel every groove of resistance. ahead is
the most stressful movie i've ever watched.
it's like an entire cemetery resurrected
and demanded breakfast to fill
the emptiness in their stomachs.
and by God, it better be ready before the
frustration of their situation sets in.
a lagoon of zombies covered in fabrics that
probably all came from Bangladesh or China
groans its discontent.

ugh.

its at times like these where I remember
that we're all just apes playing dress up.
despite millennia of innovation that led to
the grandeur of the process that
creates a big mac from farm to lab to table,
we're just trying to cosplay God
and producing a chinese knockoff at best.
